interpretations.text: The 'flat elite' of Campaign 5 may be a compute/population-size artefact: at N=200 the population max on W3_K3 exceeds the best starting parent by more than a band in three seeds. CONFOUNDED: total evaluations differ (60,000 vs 9,000-36,000). Equal-total-compute N family queued (N in 50/100/200/400 at 60,000 evaluations each).
Graph populations show two orders of magnitude fewer firings at thresholds calibrated on v0 counts; whether this is lower churn or a spread mismatch is undetermined (C6_GEOMETRY stage).
